say:2:1435404001:1.text: Hey now, don't just chug it down—say something fun while you're at it!
say:2:1435404001:1.source_cn: 哎呀，别光喝酒了，快来说点什么下酒吧！

say:3:1435404002:0.text: Did you hear? Eldric's insanely long, overly complicated plan totally flopped!
say:3:1435404002:0.source_cn: 你听说了吗？弗林那个特别漫长特别复杂的计划好像——完蛋啦！

say:4:1435404003:0.text: Heh, figures. Saw it coming a mile away.
say:4:1435404003:0.source_cn: 嗨，这有什么，早就知道了！

say:6:1435404004:1.text: Honestly, the second he started that plan, I knew it was doomed.
say:6:1435404004:1.source_cn: 都不用等他彻底失败，就他刚开始计划的时候，我就觉得这事...

say:7:1435404005:1.text: All that talk—Helthor this, Eclipsion that, volcanoes, curses... For a second, I thought they were trying to forge seven cursed magic rings or something!
say:7:1435404005:1.source_cn: 什么赫托啊杜恩加尔啊火山啊诅咒啊的，我还以为要铸造七枚...

choice_prompt:8:1435404005.text: All that talk—Helthor this, Eclipsion that, volcanoes, curses... For a second, I thought they were trying to forge seven cursed magic rings or something!
choice_prompt:8:1435404005.source_cn: 什么赫托啊杜恩加尔啊火山啊诅咒啊的，我还以为要铸造七枚有诅咒的魔法戒指呢！

say:9:1435404006:1.text: Well, of course it does! And it gets better—those pointy-eared folks got mixed up in it too!
say:9:1435404006:1.source_cn: 那当然，还有更耳熟的，就是那帮尖耳朵！

say:10:1435404008:1.text: Seven rings? Ohhh, you're talking about those seven idiots!
say:10:1435404008:1.source_cn: 七枚？我知道了，你是说那七个蠢货吧！

say:11:1435404009:1.source_cn: 对吧，就是他们，你也听说了？那七个家伙简直疯了！

choice_prompt:12:1435404009.source_cn: 对吧，就是他们，你也听说了？那七个家伙简直疯了！

say:13:1435404010:0.text: I heard they let some tall girl crash at their place—and even gave her apples!
say:13:1435404010:0.source_cn: 听说他们居然让一个高个子女孩住在家里，还给她送苹果什么的……

say:14:1435404011:1.text: No, no—wasn't it her stepmom handing out the apples? Also tall. Super dramatic.
say:14:1435404011:1.source_cn: 不是不是，送苹果的是那女孩的后妈，也是个高个子！

say:15:1435404012:1.text: Total mess! I'm telling you, getting mixed up with those delicate tallfolk never ends well.
say:15:1435404012:1.source_cn: 真的有毛病，要我说，跟那帮娇滴滴的长身人扯上关系，绝对...

say:16:1435404013:1.text: And didn't they lock her in some absurdly tall tower? She could only talk to people by tossing down her hair!
say:16:1435404013:1.source_cn: 但我听说，他们是把那女孩给关在了前所未有的高塔上，她只...

say:17:1435404014:1.text: Honestly, she should've just found herself a dwarf. We come with cozy homes and majestic beards.
say:17:1435404014:1.source_cn: 那还不如去找个矮人呢，至少矮人的胡子足够迷人！

say:18:1435404015:1.text: Anyway, rumor is those fools got summoned for questioning a few days back. Should be a public announcement soon!

say:19:1435404016:1.text: Come on, drink up! Don't let it go to waste!

say:21:1435404007:1.text: Oh, come on! What are the chances anyone here even knows the story?
say:21:1435404007:1.source_cn: 哎呀放心吧，哪有那么多懂这个的人！
